debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + MACD/AO bullish crossovers with price above key MAs provide technical structure, and extreme market fear (32/100) creates contrarian opportunity for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), weak ADX trend confirmation (13.45), below-average volume (0.82 ratio), macro crisis (VIX 299.36 + imminent CPI), zero fundamental conviction, and price below 200-EMA create compounding headwinds that outweigh technical setup.
